title: Failure Modes and Data-Efficient Remedies for Transformer-Based Prediction of Viscoplastic Flows
abstract: arXiv:2611.28267v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fast and accurate prediction of viscoplastic flows remains a challenge in computational rheology due to yield surfaces, discontinuous gradients, and strongly nonlinear transitions between yielded and unyielded regions. Transformer-based neural operators such as RheOFormer have recently shown strong potential for surrogate modeling of non-Newtonian flows. However, their applicability to viscoplastic systems and their efficacy in recovering realistic flows remain poorly understood. In this work, we present the first systematic investigation of RheOFormer applied to steady Bingham channel flow. By isolating the problem to a simple geometry and constitutive model, we examine how dataset structure, numerical value range, and input representation govern the model's ability to interpolate and extrapolate within the parameter space. translated_title: 基于Transformer的粘塑性流预测的失效模式与数据高效补救方法
translated_abstract: 由于屈服面、不连续的梯度以及屈服区与未屈服区之间强非线性的过渡，粘塑性流动的快速而准确的预测在计算流变学中仍然是一个挑战。基于Transformer的神经算子（如RheOFormer）最近在非牛顿流的代理建模方面展现出了强大的潜力。然而，它们在粘塑性系统中的适用性以及在还原真实流动方面的有效性仍知之甚少。在这项工作中，我们对应用于稳态Bingham通道流的RheOFormer进行了首次系统性研究。通过将问题限定在简单的几何形状和本构模型中，我们检验了数据集结构、数值范围和输入表示如何决定模型在参数空间内进行插值和外推的能力。研究识别出了RheOFormer保持准确的数据区间以及出现误差的数据区间，特别是……
tldr: 该论文首次系统研究了Transformer神经算子RheOFormer在稳态Bingham通道流预测中的表现，揭示了其在不同数据条件下的失效模式，并提出了数据高效的改进方案。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic investigation of the RheOFormer neural operator applied to steady Bingham channel flow, identifying its failure modes across data regimes and proposing data-efficient remedies.
